description: Where a purchase stands: waiting for the transfer, paid and waiting for the studio's approval, or approved, with links to the invoice, the certificate of authenticity and the download, which expire. While a private buyer can still withdraw (within fourteen days, until the download begins), it also gives the link to withdraw: if the buyer says they want to withdraw, give them that link. Takes the confirmation code and the buyer email.
name: acquisition_status
title: Acquisition status
